payout_anomaly.observation: Payout frequency far above configured hit probability.
payout_anomaly.method: Binomial z-test of payout-positive spins vs configured hit_probability per machine x config, Bonferroni-adjusted over all machines; monthly repeat to test persistence.
payout_anomaly.competing_explanation: Luck (a cold streak) rather than a payout-setting issue.
payout_anomaly.test_result: Hit frequency does not depend on jackpot size, so it is far less noisy than dollar win; a persistent excess in every month is inconsistent with chance. Other machines' hit z-scores have SD ~1, so the test is calibrated.
payout_anomaly.limitations: Cannot distinguish misconfigured paytable from meter or game-software fault; physical inspection is needed to confirm.

walkway_closure.observation: Walkway W-ENT-B40 (Z-ENT<->Z-B40) closed for renovation, gaming dates 2025-03-03 to 2025-04-06.
walkway_closure.hypothesis: The closure cut Back Forty demand beyond any floor-wide trend.
walkway_closure.alternative: Back Forty's dip reflects floor-wide seasonality or machine changes.
walkway_closure.method: Daily log ratio of target-zone to rest-of-floor theo per available hour on a fixed set of machines that never moved; OLS with weekday effects and closure/post indicators; HAC (Newey-West, 7 lags) errors.
walkway_closure.limitations: Single event, so effect size has wide uncertainty; traffic counters count crossings not people; theo per hour also reflects bet size.

downtime_by_manufacturer.observation: Ridgeline machines have the highest downtime share.
downtime_by_manufacturer.competing_explanation: Machine age (older machines fail more), not manufacturer.
downtime_by_manufacturer.method: Poisson regression of fault counts with log(active days) offset on manufacturer and age.
downtime_by_manufacturer.limitations: Lost theo assumes downtime hours would have been played at the machine's average rate; downtime may cluster in quiet hours (overstates) or busy hours (understates).

comp_rate_change.observation: Points required per comp dollar fell around gaming date 2025-05-01.
comp_rate_change.competing_explanation: Tier mix: more Platinum/Gold redemptions (cheaper tiers) rather than a price change.
comp_rate_change.test_result: The rate roughly halves within every tier, so tier mix cannot explain the step; mix explains only the gradual pre-change drift.
comp_rate_change.limitations: Redemption timing lags the change; two months post-change may not show the full cost response. Unredeemed points are not valued: the data cannot show how many will ever be redeemed.
